Question: After boiling eggs how can I easily remove the shells?
Answer: I crack the shell with a spoon, or if I have more than one egg to peel I bash them lightly together. Give them a good cracking all over, then find a big hole in the shell that I can get a nail under. Ideally you want to get under the membrane between the shell and the white, and peel that off, which will take the shell with it.
